# Grandmoor Inc.

> Grandmoor is a founder-led, HACCP-certified third-party logistics (3PL) warehouse in Mississauga, Ontario, serving businesses across the Greater Toronto Area. It offers pallet storage with a single-pallet minimum, contract warehousing without a long-term lease, e-commerce order fulfillment, cross-docking, container destuffing and inventory management.

- Address: 3500 Ridgeway Drive, Mississauga, ON L5L 0A2, Canada
- Phone: 1-888-505-6667 (toll-free), 647-237-3050
- Email: info@grandmoor.com
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 9:00 to 18:00
- Areas served: Mississauga, Toronto, Brampton, Etobicoke and the wider GTA
- Certification: HACCP-certified; most customers are food and beverage businesses
- Accepted goods: all product types except hazardous materials
- Minimums: no minimum pallet count; tiered per-pallet pricing (lower rate per pallet at higher volumes)
- Lead time: 8 hours' notice for inbound and outbound shipments
- Contracts: no minimum contract length (first-month-free promotion requires a six-month minimum)
- Facility: 27,000 sq ft warehouse with 6 dock doors, 24 ft clear height and ambient temperature-controlled storage
- Location: near Toronto Pearson International Airport with access to Highways 401, 403, 407 and the QEW

## Services

- [3PL Warehousing](https://grandmoor.ca/3pl-warehousing): third-party warehousing and distribution from Mississauga
- [Pallet Storage](https://grandmoor.ca/pallet-storage): palletized racking storage, no minimum pallet count
- [Contract Warehousing](https://grandmoor.ca/contract-warehousing): dedicated warehouse space without signing a lease
- [Order Fulfillment](https://grandmoor.ca/order-fulfillment): e-commerce pick, pack and ship
- [Cross-Docking](https://grandmoor.ca/cross-docking): inbound-to-outbound transfers for freight that needs to keep moving
- [Container Destuffing](https://grandmoor.ca/container-destuffing): container unloading for importers
- [Inventory Management](https://grandmoor.ca/inventory-management): cycle counts, SKU tracking and reporting
